properties.site-address: Lynemouth Garage, West Market Street, Lynemouth
properties.notes: Opportunity for redevelopment of former post office and garage site. Through the SHLAA, a yield of 6 dwellings is identified between two sites (3049 and 3076) with indicative delivery recorded against the latter. A planning application relating to the two sites was approved but never implemented and has now lapsed (CM/20090251). This would have seen the demolition of the existing buildings and a new-build scheme of 6 apartments. The yield identified in the SHLAA continues to reflect a higher density flat/apartment development. Prior to the above proposal, a previous application, also for 6 units, was withdrawn (CM/20080727). Capacity recorded against site 3049.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
